limitations: Cancelling an active Ghidra request terminates its ephemeral database and discards session annotations. The selected target remains open; the next provider query imports the original artifact again.
Default-space addresses use lowercase 0x-prefixed hexadecimal; other address spaces use <percent-encoded-space>:0x<hex>.

Ghidra Program checkpoint mode is disabled: closing discards metadata edits; original executable bytes are unchanged. For stock ELF/PE/Mach-O on Linux/macOS, set REA_GHIDRA_CHECKPOINT_DIR to a private absolute directory before starting REA (restart MCP after changing its startup environment).

Regex mode uses Java Pattern semantics. Matcher or compiler stack exhaustion returns a resource constraint without closing the session; literal mode avoids regex recursion and returns complete matching values.
The session serves operations only after Ghidra reports default auto-analysis complete; incomplete analysis does not expose partial results.
unknowns: Counts and paging describe the retained provider-reported rows, not complete discovery of every program object. Missing matches do not establish absence outside that observation.
